turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friend's company is hiring and she offered to set up a coffee with her boss. Is that an interview or not?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's informal, but treat it as a gentle interview. First impressions still count.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I'm finally getting pet insurance for my two year old lab. The choices are confusing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They really are. Would you go for a cheaper accident only policy, or a lifetime one that covers illness every year?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The kids are fighting again. Sorry, I'll come back to you when it's sorted.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Leo, are we still on for the Saturday bootcamp in the park, the one with the hill sprints?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ugh, I forgot I said yes to that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You were so excited on Monday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Monday me is very brave. Saturday me wants pancakes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We can get pancakes after. Will you come if I drive?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine, but if I collapse on the hill, you carry me down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll bring water and sympathy. Mostly water.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Great. Pick me up at nine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They've gone, so we're good. Carry on.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. The lab's insurance. Accident only, or lifetime?
